args.body: The original dollar-sign search returned zero items; corrected search found exactly five candidates in products/research/bounty-expensify-candidates-corrected.json, compacted in bounty-candidate-summary.json. Inspect issue 104951 comments first if FETCH succeeds. Limit discovery to these five. Official contributing guide requires accepted proposal before PR, verified Upwork account, reproduction and platform testing; advertised $250 is neither verified funding nor eligibility. Determine whether an existing proposal is accepted; assignees alone do not prove allocation. Save the required opportunity verdict with precise prerequisites and reject implementation if inaccessible. Do not submit or contact anyone. EXEC uses python3; python executable was unavailable. Read the artifact before completing with a lesson. Preserve independent review before any public deployment.

description: Corrected the empty bounty search: five open Expensify issues advertise $250 each. Rewards and payout eligibility remain unverified; official rules require an accepted proposal and verified Upwork account before paid work.
